descriptionByLocale.en: True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in terms of ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples and the development of process sensors. The Process Analytics business unit develops, produces and distributes the latest process measurement technology for customers in biopharmaceuticals, chemicals and breweries. Our product portfolio includes sensors for critical process parameters such as pH, oxygen or sensors for measuring cell density, which are extremely important in biological processes and are unique worldwide with their innovative technology. As an employee in the «Product Master Data / Change Management» team, you accompany the products during their life cycle as part of an interdisciplinary team from market launch to termination. You ensure that all changes, whether to the product or its processes, are coordinated and carried out in high quality in the form of change projects. As a Master Data Manager in Product Master Data / Change Management, you work in a dynamic team and are responsible for all Engineering Change Orders in the entire product portfolio of the Business Unit Process Analytics. - Cross-departmental planning and coordination of changes including effectiveness testing (Engineering Change Orders). These include product expansion, product maintenance, product change and process change - implementation and documentation of the product master data changes in the ERP system (D365) - preparation and support for the transfer to production You bring with you : - Technical-commercial training - Experience in the coordination and communication of tasks in the matrix organization - High quality understanding as well as understanding of connected processes - Good English and very good German skills in word and writing - Experience / knowledge in the ERP system Microsoft Dynamics 365 is advantageous - Careful and reliable working methods as well as independent interdisciplinary work Find out more about career opportunities at Hamilton at jobs.hamilton.ch .
